notes: Kernel time excludes graph load/preprocess. On directed CSR, each arc is treated as undirected (WCC). Parallel variants compare partitions to serial union-find (label values may differ). rounds counts hooking / LP iterations. distribution_time_ms is the 1D edge slice and is excluded from kernel time. compute_ms/comm_ms are the slowest rank's phase split (comm includes wait inside MPI). bytes_sent sums Allreduce payloads.
